team.does: Menu, buying, orders, money, customer messages
Cooking and packing, six mornings a week

routines.name: Morning cook and pack
steps: Check the order count sent the night before
Pack and label each box by floor
Hand the boxes to the rider by 12:15

routines.name: Delivery run
steps: Message the owner when the last box is handed over

routines.name: Order cut-off and buying list
steps: Send the count to the cook

routines.name: Weekly menu and supplier order
steps: Place the vegetable and grocery order

routines.name: Month-end money check
steps: Pay the cook, the rider and the suppliers

routines.name: Missed or late delivery
steps: Credit the day as the promise says

dependencies.name: The cook
dependencies.if_lost: No food goes out that day
dependencies.fallback: Owner cooks a two-dish menu; a second cook is on call at a day rate

dependencies.name: Rented kitchen
dependencies.fallback: Owner has a quote from a second shared kitchen 2 km away

dependencies.name: Food business licence
dependencies.if_lost: Selling must stop until it is renewed
dependencies.fallback: Renewal date is in the calendar 60 days ahead

dependencies.name: Payment collection service
dependencies.fallback: Bank transfer to the business account with a reference

dependencies.name: Tech park access for the rider
dependencies.fallback: Hand over at the lobby desk, customers collect

support.channel: A phone number that takes messages, printed on every box

legal.note: Owner holds it; renewal date noted

legal.item: Written terms for the weekly subscription and refunds
legal.note: Take the draft to a lawyer

legal.item: Agreement with the cook and the rider
legal.note: Ask an accountant how each should be paid

kpis.name: Boxes delivered by 1 pm
kpis.how_measured: Rider's last-box message time, each day

kpis.name: Subscribers who renew for a second week
Food cost per box
kpis.how_measured: Week's buying bills divided by boxes sent
